capabilities: Tint tab headers with colors from an editable palette
Apply or clear tints via commands and hotkeys
Merge duplicate tabs showing the same file
Auto-pin tinted tabs and follow tints through file renames
Adjust tab text ink for readability on any tint color
extras: The README warns that Obsidian has no public API for styling tab headers, so the plugin reads two undocumented internals; a future Obsidian update could make tints silently stop applying until the plugin is updated.
motivation: The author built it because scanning tabs by title during researching, cross-referencing, and writing is slow, and color lets the eyes jump straight to the right tab.
problem: When working across several open notes, finding the right tab by its title alone is slow.
summary: Tab header tinting plugin that assigns palette colors to open tabs so notes are distinguishable at a glance.
